drivingQuestion: What distinguishes liability for a tam from a muad?

segments.en: «MISHNA:» «What» is the difference «between» the liability incurred for damage caused by an ox that is considered «innocuous and» the liability incurred for damage caused by an ox that is «forewarned?»

segments.he: אֶלָּא שֶׁהַתָּם מְשַׁלֵּם חֲצִי נֶזֶק מִגּוּפוֹ, וּמוּעָד מְשַׁלֵּם נֶזֶק שָׁלֵם מִן הָעֲלִיָּיה.
segments.en: The «only» differences are «that» for damage caused by «an innocuous» ox, the owner «pays half» the cost of «the damage» exclusively «from» proceeds of the sale «of the body» of the ox, «and» for «a forewarned» ox «he pays the full» cost of the «damage from» his «higher» property.

moves.summary: asks the difference between tam and muad

moves.cueHe: אלא שהתם משלם חצי נזק מגופו
moves.summary: tam: half from its body; muad: full from aliyya

positions.claim: tam pays half damages from its body; muad pays full damages from the owner's best property
